$comment: Ratchet baseline for the workspace-root Biome gate (MDRS-15).
`biome ci .` checked 521 files and reported 0 errors, 94 warnings, 27 infos
while still exiting 0 — so the per-project `lint` target could never fail on a
warn-severity rule. These counts are the ceiling: CI fails when any count grows.
Driving them to zero is MDRS-21's job. When you fix diagnostics, lower the
numbers here in the same PR (the gate prints the new values for you).
